description.value: The Charles Jago Northern Sport Centre is a four-season fitness and recreation facility on the UNBC Prince George campus, open to community members, families, seniors, and students alike. It features modern fitness equipment, group fitness and drop-in classes, two squash courts, pickleball, and the only indoor running track in northern British Columbia. Touring cyclists passing through Prince George could potentially use the facility for recovery workouts, though cyclist-specific services are not documented on the website.
